messages:
Maya: Quick design review request — attaching the dashboard mock + short clip of keyboard navigation: https://img.redwood/dev/dash-kb.mov @Sam can you do a quick a11y pass? I'm worried about contrast on the metric labels and whether keyboard users can get to the filter chips reliably. Sam: Ran a fast axe + Lighthouse sweep on the static mock. High level: color contrast fail on metric label (#6B6B6B on #FFFFFF -> ~3.8:1), focus ring not visible for the ghost buttons (outline is 0 on focus), and cards are missing region landmarks / aria-labelledby so screen readers treat them as generic content. Also route changes don't set focus to main region so NVDA users aren't notified on view change. A11yBot: automated-scan: issues found = 7; critical: color-contrast (1), focus-order (1), region (2). See report: https://a11y.redwood/reports/1758204321-summary.json :eyes: Alex: Thanks, Sam. Implementation notes: changing color tokens is easy — we can update token --text-subtle to `#333333` or `var(--text-weak-2)` to hit 7:1. Focus ring — we should use `:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-accent); outline-offset: 2px; }` instead of relying on box-shadow. For cards, we can add `
` and ensure the title has that id. The tricky part is virtualized list; we'll generate stable ids for visible items to keep aria attributes consistent. Jordan: Prioritization: This should be a patch release (low risk, high impact). Can we get a PR in the next sprint? Also want a short item in release notes: "Accessibility: improved keyboard focus and contrast on dashboard". Sam: Proposed acceptance criteria: 1) All body text >= 4.5:1, headings >= 3:1; 2) Visible focus outline for all interactive controls (keyboard only) matching design token; 3) Dashboard cards have role=region + aria-labelledby; 4) Route changes focus main region and announce view change (aria-live or focus move). I'll write a short checklist and sample snippets. Example skip link: `Skip to main content` and in markup: `
`. Focus snippet for CSS: ```css .skip-link { position: absolute; left: -999px; } .skip-link:focus { left: 16px; top: 8px; } :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #FFB238; outline-offset: 2px; } ``` Alex: Will add the skip link, main landmark, and change tokens. For the virtualized cards I'll emit `aria-posinset` and `aria-setsize` for position announcements and use `aria-roledescription="dashboard card"` for clarity. Example card markup: `
`. We'll also ensure `focus()` is called after route transitions (only when triggered by keyboard or link). Maya: Great. Owners: Alex -> implement tokens, focus styles, skip link, card attributes. Sam -> final acceptance criteria & run manual NVDA/VoiceOver pass. QA -> add regression tests for keyboard nav and contrast. Jordan -> include a small blurb in release notes. Target: PR by 1758780000 (sprint end). QA: I'll add automated contrast checks and a keyboard smoke test to the regression suite. Can you drop final color swatches and the focus token name, Alex? Also need screenshots for visual test harness. Alex: Dropping token names here: `--text-subtle` -> `#333333`, `--focus-accent` -> `#FFB238`. I'll push a WIP PR and attach screenshots. Sam: I'll prepare the audit checklist and add a few screen-reader test scripts (NVDA + ChromeVox + VoiceOver). Maya: Thanks team :thumbsup: Let's reconvene if anything blocks the PR.
